content: TypeORM postgres enum migrations: migration:generate often produces blank/incorrect migrations when enum values are added; TypeORM's default 4-step enum-change migration (rename type, create new type, alter column, drop old type) locks the whole table on large tables. Postgres 12+ ALTER TYPE ... ADD VALUE is non-locking and should be used via raw SQL in migrations instead of relying on generated migrations, especially since enum arrays crash TypeORM's generator.
